label: 2025 backcast (calibration)
description: 2025 Henry Hub strip (approx.), weak Quebec imports, pre-Revolution Wind fleet. Compared against ISO-NE IMM 2025 results.

label: 2027 Base
description: Reference case: 2027 gas strip assumption, +2.5% load with heat-pump growth, Vineyard Wind 1 and Revolution Wind online, normal Quebec hydrology.

label: Arctic cold snap
description: Base 2027 with a 9-day late-January arctic outbreak (daily means near 0F), stressing the gas-electric interface.

label: Cold snap + LNG import loss
description: Cold snap with regasified LNG send-out cut from 0.70 to 0.25 Bcf/d (e.g., Everett terminal unavailable).

label: Offshore wind + storage build
description: Base 2027 plus 2,400 MW additional offshore wind landing in SEMA/RI and 1,000 MW of 4-hour batteries.

label: Pipeline +0.5 Bcf/d
description: Base 2027 with 0.5 Bcf/d of incremental firm interstate pipeline capacity into New England.

label: High carbon price
description: Base 2027 with a $50/ton CO2 price (tighter RGGI cap / state clean-energy policy).
